name: brewkit
description: BrewKit. Hunter Brewer's personal Claude Code toolkit.

plugins.name: school
plugins.description: Coursework tooling: NotebookLM sync, rubric checks, AI-detection scans.

plugins.name: personal
plugins.description: Personal-life tooling. Apple Calendar read and write via EventKit.

plugins.name: misc
plugins.description: Cross-cutting tooling: toolkit management, Word documents, NotebookLM, tailnet transfers, and the global hooks.

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Development workflow chain: spec, plan, implement, review, test.

plugins.name: meta-builders
plugins.description: Skill authoring and evaluation suite: skill-creator with eval and benchmark scripts.

plugins.name: checklist
plugins.description: Mod: checklist for the current plan, with the subagents working each step, shown as a section in the sidebar.

plugins.name: sidebar
plugins.description: Mod: a docked sidebar for widget mods, with one tab per widget or one stacked pane, in a configurable order.

plugins.name: questions
plugins.description: Mod: non-blocking questions Claude asks with a stated default, answered from the sidebar.

plugins.name: processes
plugins.description: Mod: background processes and dev servers Claude started, with ports, uptime and a kill button.

plugins.name: review-pair
plugins.description: Mod: pairs each builder session with a reviewer session that reviews every commit, sends blockers back to the builder, and shows the rest in the sidebar.
